summary: This bill requires the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives (ATF) to process most permit applications within 90 days, and license applications within 60 days, while also mandating quarterly public and congressional reports on application processing metrics and establishing an appeals process for applicants.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses the processing of applications by the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives (ATF), including those related to licenses under section 923 of title 18, United States Code, which pertains to firearms. By mandating deadlines and reporting for these applications, the bill aims to streamline the process for individuals and entities seeking to exercise rights related to firearms, thus protecting gun rights by reducing administrative hurdles.
